gloss: advance payment; prepayment; payment in advance

definitions.gloss: advance payment; prepayment; payment in advance
definitions.explanation: Paying for goods or services before they are delivered or rendered. A common payment arrangement in Japanese commerce and daily life.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先払|さきばら}いです。
⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{先払|さきばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: Rent is paid in advance each month.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネットショッピング→ネットショッピング：29757_nettoshoppingu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先払|さきばら}い⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{後払|あとばら}い→後払い：17771_atobarai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どちらか→どちらか：28669_dochiraka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}べる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: When shopping online, you can often choose between advance payment and pay-later options.

notes:
Common in restaurants (especially ramen shops and fast-food), vending machine purchases, and online shopping. Many Japanese restaurants use ticket machines (⟦{食券|しょっけん}→食券：19934_shokken⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧) that operate on a {先払|さきばら}い system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先払|さきばら}い⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: prepayment system
- {先払|さきばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: by advance payment
- ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧{先払|さきばら}い: prepaid fee
- {先払|さきばら}い⟦チャージ→チャージ：09729_chaaji⟧: prepaid charge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後払|あとばら}い→後払い：17771_atobarai⟧: deferred payment; pay later — the opposite; paying after receiving goods or services
- ⟦{前払|まえばら}い→前払い：15782_maebarai⟧: prepayment — very similar; ⟦{前払|まえばら}い→前払い：15782_maebarai⟧ is more common in accounting and formal business contexts
- ⟦{代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}→代金引換：28163_daikinhikikae⟧: cash on delivery (COD) — paying at the time of delivery
